description: ReviewBench pilot suite — one PR, converted from github.com/review-bench/ReviewBench's golden format into this bench's schema. Seeded to measure whether keyword-substring signatures survive ReviewBench's finding density (~19 findings per PR) before the remaining 218 PRs are converted. Deliberately NOT representative: it is the smallest Go PR in the corpus and it sits in ReviewBench's 25-PR test set.
verified: 2026-10-07: both frozen SHAs confirmed reachable from https://github.com/k1LoW/gh-copilot-review (refs/heads/* plus refs/pull/9/head).

prs.notes: ReviewBench corpus entry k1LoW/gh-copilot-review#9 (language Go, 2 files, 68 changed lines). ReviewBench freezes base/head at capture time; the PR's live refs/pull/9/head has since moved to 395fb81237f1cce30bfbdfa7b24a53edc3ce8e93, so head_sha here is the FROZEN commit, not the current PR head. merge_sha is set to head_sha with merge_strategy 'squash' so resolve_diff_range takes the single-parent path and yields base..head, matching ReviewBench's own three-dot base...head diff. The id is owner-qualified because ReviewBench's corpus holds 18 duplicate bare repo names and PR_ID_RE forbids a slash.
